## API

`POST /api/v1/analyze`

Request fields:

- `category`: non-empty category or `all`
- `minimum_value`: integer greater than or equal to zero

Response fields:

- category, count, total, and average
- input and configuration SHA-256 provenance

`GET /health` returns `{"status": "ok"}`.

The development dependency `httpx2` supplies the transport used by the current Starlette/FastAPI `TestClient` in `tests/test_api.py`.

## Commands

| Command | Contract |
|---|---|
| `uv run reproduce --check` | Verify deterministic batch output. |
| `quarto render app` | Build the static product client. |
| `uv run uvicorn static_quarto_application.api:app` | Serve the API and rendered app on one origin. |
| `uv run pytest tests/test_api.py` | Verify API validation and known results. |
| `uv run pytest -m browser tests/test_browser.py` | Verify the tutorial interaction against the served artifact after rendering `app/` and installing Chromium. |
